verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own workflow automation feature lets users set up flows and triggered events that run without manual action, including automatic lead scoring and lead assignment. That covers the core of background autonomous automation. The evidence is marketing-level only, with no detail on trigger and condition depth, scheduling, or AI-driven agentic behavior. Missing for 10: detailed docs on trigger, condition and action options and recurring schedules, evidence of AI or agent-driven autonomous automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Set up flows and triggered events so that tasks happen without you having to lift a finger.
